notes: CANONICAL (research 2026-07-04): this copy of Mary Margaret Valentine — though unsourced in this tree — is the one that continues the direct line. Independently confirmed via WikiTree (Valentine-570): daughter of Richard Valentine (I182541956481) and (probably) Deborah Mott, wife of Thomas Cheesman/Cheeseman (I182197729555). Richard Valentine's own unrecorded 1682 Hempstead will (Long Island Historical Society collection, per rootsweb ~valvz Valentine research) names 'his daughter, Mary, wife of Thomas Cheesman' — independent, will-based confirmation of the marriage. genealogieonline.nl ('From Castles to America') independently gives Richard Cheesman Sr.'s parents as Thomas Cheesman (1640-1713) and Mary Margaret Valentine (1645-1710), matching this tree.
